profile.org_note: Until the 2026-05-04 sale, UHG reported three segments (GSH South Carolina incl. Augusta GA; Rosewood move-up homes; Other = Raleigh NC plus the Homeowners Mortgage JV) run through Midlands, Coastal and Upstate SC, Augusta and Raleigh divisions, and every new land deal was approved by a Land Investment Committee of the CEO/President, Co-COOs and CFO, with division leadership presenting deals. At closing all UHG officers (CEO Jack Micenko, CFO Keith Feldman, Exec Chairman/founder Michael Nieri, Co-COOs Shelton Twine and Jeremy Pyle, CAO Tom O'Grady, EVP Sales Rob Penny) ceased to be officers and all directors left; UHG is now a wholly owned subsidiary of Stanley Martin Homes, and land and capital decisions now sit with Stanley Martin (Reston, VA: CEO Steve Alloy), whose division presidents in Greenville, Florence/SC and coastal Carolina now front the former GSH markets. No post-merger GSH-specific land or finance head is named publicly.
profile.summary: Columbia/Chapin, SC entry-level builder (Great Southern Homes brand, founded 2004 by Michael Nieri, ~11,000 homes built) that closed 1,192 homes in 2025 across the Midlands, Upstate and Coastal SC, Augusta GA and Raleigh NC. It ran a very land-light model: at 2025-12-31, 96% of 7,225 lots were controlled by option contracts with third-party developers, Nieri-related developers and land banks. Stanley Martin Homes (Daiwa House Group) bought it for about $221M enterprise value in cash, closing 2026-05-04; it is being folded into Stanley Martin's Carolinas divisions, so land-bank conversations now run through Stanley Martin, not a stand-alone UHG team.
